# Modal

A dialog up to 600px wide over a 60% black backdrop. It scales in from 98% with the spring curve over 450ms and leaves in 200ms. Focus moves to the close button, Tab stays inside, and Escape, the button or the backdrop close it and send focus back.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/modal)

## Usage

```tsx
<Modal open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title="Refund policy">
  <p>We have a 30-day return policy…</p>
</Modal>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` | Whether it is shown. It stays mounted for 200ms after closing to finish the exit. |
| `onClose` | `() => void` | Close button, Escape or backdrop. |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | Heading; also labels the dialog for screen readers. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Scrolls if taller than 80% of the window. |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | Accessible name of the close button. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `Modal.module.css`
- `Modal.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/icons`](../../icons)
- [`src/lib/motion.ts`](../../lib/motion.ts)
- [`src/theme`](../../theme)
- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
